title: Touhou Fuujinroku ~ Mountain of Faith - Because Princess Inada is Scolding Me
description:
Minoriko's theme from Mountain of Faith.

A short, upbeat song that probably best fits early-game boss battles, or possibly any kind of minigame or puzzle. The song alternates between slightly tense sections and calmer ones, while always being pressingly happy, in a way.

2020/07/03 update: Overhauled instrumentation, made SFX cutoff less prominent.
